description: Finds a substance by name, form, synonym or ID. Omega-3 and fish oil identify EPA and DHA separately. Returns forms and the applicable country limit, then other countries’ limits with their scope, sources and recorded dates where available. Use detail "full" for form details, references and a link to search published products. Reference data only: it does not cover medication interactions, diagnosis or treatment decisions.

country.description: The United States is the only market currently available.

detail.description: Compact answer by default. Use full for the complete published record.

name.description: Substance name, e.g. "Vitamin D", as an alternative to id.
